map.采购部门制定补货策略时，用 EOQ 平衡订货成本与持有成本，确定每次最优订货量。: When the purchasing department sets a replenishment strategy, it uses EOQ to balance ordering cost against holding cost and determine the optimal quantity per order.
map.面对需求波动与不确定提前期，用安全库存与再订货点 ROP 设定补货触发线，防止缺: Facing demand fluctuation and uncertain lead times, use safety stock and the reorder point ROP to set the replenishment trigger line and prevent line stoppages from material shortages.
map.年度库存复盘时，用总库存成本（订货+持有）评估当前策略是否经济，优化订货频率。: At the annual inventory review, use the total inventory cost (ordering plus holding) to assess whether the current strategy is economical and to optimize order frequency.

map.5、服务水平 95%（Z=1.65）。EOQ = √(2×12000×50÷2): standard deviation 5, service level 95% (Z = 1.65). EOQ = √(2 × 12000 × 50 ÷ 2) ≈ 775 units; annual orders 12000 ÷ 775 ≈ 15.5 times (a cycle of about 24 days); average inventory ≈ 387 units; safety stock = 1.65 × 5 × √7 ≈ 22 units; reorder point ROP = 33 × 7 + 22 ≈ 253 units; minimum total inventory cost ≈ √(2 × 12000 × 50 × 2) ≈ 1549 CNY.
map.EOQ 越大越好还是越小越好？: Is a larger or a smaller EOQ better?
map.EOQ 是总成本最低点：订货量过大增加持有成本，过小增加订货频次与订货成本。EO: EOQ is the point of lowest total cost: too large an order quantity raises holding cost, while too small a quantity raises order frequency and ordering cost. The EOQ formula √(2DS/H) already balances the two, and in practice safety stock must be added on top to absorb fluctuation.
map.再订货点 ROP 怎么用？: How is the reorder point ROP used?
map.库存降到 ROP（日均需求×提前期 + 安全库存）时即触发订货，确保提前期内不断: When inventory falls to the ROP (average daily demand × lead time + safety stock), an order is triggered, ensuring no stockout during the lead time. The higher the service level (larger Z) and the greater the demand fluctuation, the higher the safety stock and the ROP.
map.关于「库存计算器 - EOQ安全库存」: About the inventory calculator - EOQ safety stock
map.经济订货量 EOQ = √(2DS/H)；平均库存 = EOQ/2；安全库存 =: EOQ = √(2DS/H); average inventory = EOQ/2; safety stock = Z·σ·√L; reorder point ROP = d·L + safety stock; minimum annual cost = √(2DSH) (D annual demand, S order cost, H holding cost, Z service factor)
map.向上取整（安全库存/订货点建议）: Round up (recommended for safety stock / reorder point)
map.件数为小数时，可按业务单位选择“向上取整”或“四舍五入”；安全库存与订货点建议向: When quantities are fractional, choose “round up” or “round to nearest” for your business unit; safety stock and reorder point should round up so required inventory is not rounded down.
map.5、服务水平 95%（Z=1.65）。EOQ = √(2×12000×50÷2): 5, service level 95% (Z = 1.65). EOQ = √(2×12,000×50÷2) ≈ 775 pieces; orders per year 12,000÷775 ≈ 15.5 (cycle about 24 days); cycle average inventory (EOQ/2) ≈ 387 pieces; safety stock = 1.65×5×√7 ≈ 21.83 pieces, rounded up to 22; reorder point ROP = 33×7 + 21.83 ≈ 252.83 pieces, rounded up to 253; total average inventory including safety stock ≈ 387+22 = 409 pieces; EOQ optimal total cost (excluding safety stock) ≈ √(2×12,000×50×2) ≈ 1,549 yuan; the annual total cost including safety stock must add holding cost on 409 pieces.
map.为什么安全库存和订货点要向上取整？: Why round safety stock and the reorder point up?
map.安全库存与订货点是触发补货的底线，向下取整会让实际持有低于模型要求、增加缺料风险: Safety stock and the reorder point are the floor for triggering replenishment; rounding down leaves actual inventory below the model requirement and raises stockout risk, while rounding up is more conservative. The tool defaults to round-up and also offers round-to-nearest, but be aware of the service-level bias from the rounding direction.
map.平均库存为什么有两个数？: Why are there two average-inventory figures?
map.EOQ/2 只是周期库存（不含安全库存）；含安全库存的总平均库存 = EOQ/2: EOQ/2 is only cycle stock (excluding safety stock); total average inventory including safety stock = EOQ/2 + safety stock. Costs are also split into “EOQ optimal total cost (excluding safety stock)” and “annual total cost including safety stock”, which must not be mixed.
